participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Curious and playful, enjoys imaginative play and storytelling.
participant_1.background: I'm in the third grade. Mickey Mouse is my favorite character. I love to go to Disney World every year. I love to sing songs from the movie Frozen. I play with my friends on the playground.

participant_2.name: Mr. Johnson
participant_2.personality: Friendly and supportive, enjoys sharing music with children and encouraging creativity.
participant_2.background: My favorite band is UP and I got to see them in concert once. I'm an elementary school teacher. My parents were also teachers. For vacation, I enjoy time at the beach.
